subject_line: Acme Corp Weekly Brief: Conversions Up 24%, CPA Beats Target | Week of Jan 13

body.headline: Strong week: conversions up 24% to 78 as new landing page and ad copy tests drove efficiency. CPA at $42 vs. $50 target. On pace for best month yet.
wins: CPA dropped 15% to $42, well below our $50 target. The new landing page (launched Tuesday) is converting at a higher rate—early data shows 18% improvement in page conversion rate.
Product Features campaign conversions up 23% after new RSA variations launched last week started winning impressions. The 'Free Demo' messaging is outperforming.
concerns: Competitor campaign CPA remains high at $89.50. Conversions dropped further this week. Recommend pausing to reallocate budget unless conquesting is strategic priority.

top_performer.name: Brand - Exact
top_performer.insight: Brand searches increasing—likely driven by recent PR coverage
top_performer.action: Maintain. Consider expanding brand terms to capture variations.

needs_attention.name: Non-Brand - Competitor
needs_attention.insight: Competitor conquesting historically low ROI. Users searching for competitors rarely switch.
needs_attention.action: Recommend pausing and reallocating $350/week to Product Features campaign.

completed: Launched 3 new RSA variations in Product Features → Early winner identified ('Free Demo' CTA)
Added 15 negative keywords from search term review → Blocked ~$200/month in irrelevant spend
next_week: A/B test new landing page headline (hypothesis: specificity will improve CVR)
Expand exact match coverage in Product Features based on converting search terms
Review Competitor campaign—prepare pause recommendation if CPA doesn't improve

body.closing:
Overall, a strong week. The new landing page is already showing impact, and we have room to scale the winning campaigns. Main decision point: whether to continue the Competitor campaign or reallocate that budget.

Let me know if you have questions or want to discuss the Competitor campaign strategy.
